verdict.rationale: Cursor's own agent produces AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's code, which is the user's data here. It traces how a repo fits together, narrows root causes, and Bugbot identifies bugs, security and quality problems with suggested fixes. The evidence is code-centric and thin on general data insights, and team usage data is exposed only via APIs rather than as AI-generated insights in the product. missing for 10: AI insights over non-code data inside the product, in-product AI analysis of usage/analytics data, depth documentation of insight features, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start
Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix
Bugbot reviews pull requests and identifies bugs, security issues, and code quality problems
